checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 16:9 and show three distinct scenes at 0.9, 3.6, 6.3 and 8.6 s, but the exact cut points cannot be checked from four frames. The 6.3 s frame has no text, which suggests scene 3 text may start late.

must.item: Scene 1 reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
must.why: It reads 'Less scrorling, More doing.' This has a misspelling and a comma in place of the period.

must.item: Scene 2 reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
must.why: The text is correct, though it overlaps the calendar.
The text is correct at 8.6 s.

must.item: Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and unaltered
must.why: Scene 1 text is altered. No extra words are visible.

must.item: Silent, cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation
must.why: The palette is cream and green, with a calendar grid and checkmarks. Silence cannot be verified from frames.

exact_text.text: Plan your day in one place.
exact_text.read_as: Plan your day in one place.

faults.what: Scene 1 text is misspelled ('scrorling') and has a comma in place of the period, so it is not the exact line requested.
Scene 2 text sits over the calendar grid, which reduces legibility and looks cluttered.
The 6.3 s frame shows only a checkmark with no text, so scene 3 text may appear late or scene timing may be uneven.
The green circles with stems in the corners are odd decorative shapes. They look like AI artefacts and were not requested.

summary: The cream-and-green ad looks clean and two of the three lines are exact, but the first line reads 'Less scrorling, More doing.', which is a misspelling and wrong punctuation, so the client would reject it.
